steps.content:
<color=#FDF9BA><i>Under the eternal Golden Rose,

you must now take this oath:</color>
Ah!!!
Yes, I swear.
Do you hereby swear that you will do everything in your power to carry forward the guidance of your great predecessors and never dishonor the glory bestowed upon your shoulders?
Yes, I will be true to my word and deed, never forgetting the compassion and justice in my heart.
Finally, do you swear before the Golden Rose that no matter the hardship, whatever the cost, you will never abandon your duty or betray your oath?
Even if...
the price is everything you hold dear?
The girl opens her eyes.
Sunlight pours through the wide window, cutting the room cleanly in half.
She stands beside the operation station. Liquid metal flows silently before her, gradually separating, merging, and realigning until it forms an integrated spiral.

Following her movements, the spiral continues to extend, assembling into an intricate yet elegant structure. The finely layered metal constructs itself tier by tier, reflecting scattered points of light.
[1 second pause, communication stone sound effect plays - use a sound similar to Schorl, not electronic]
The metal's growth halts. The girl looks toward the communicator on the other side of the room, takes a deep breath, and answers the call.
Routine report No. 8.

The latest shielding device is almost ready for deployment. Currently, material consumption remains higher than projected. We need to continue gathering data to complete the final optimization. However...
The girl breathes in deeply, slowly clenching her fist until her fingertips dig into her palm. Light streams through the floor-to-ceiling window, but fails to reach where she stands.
Regarding the calamity beyond the city walls... <color=#fb9259>That thing</color> has been acting up more and more frequently.

DisCity continues to restrict Hypercube exports, and now there are many injured people within our city. Our equipment and supplies aren't sufficient for long-term resistance against it. If we could secure support from the family, our progress would certainly be more promising. Besides, things in DisCity...

steps.speaker: Stern Voice
steps.content: Hypatia.
The girl is interrupted. She lifts her head as a cold light pulses from the top of the communicator before her.

steps.speaker: Stern Voice
steps.content: Just focus on what you should be doing. Don't forget the true purpose of our Aurum Secretum research.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...Yes, I understand.
The communication crystal flashes a few more times before going completely out. The room falls silent, leaving only the sound of the girl's suppressed breathing.

Metal components awaiting adjustment lie abandoned on the operation station. Hypatia walks to the window, her gaze sweeping across the town below before fixing on the pitch-black storm gradually approaching from the distance.
Black sand fills the sky as Mania howls through the wind, swallowing every existence caught in its path. It looms overhead like an eternal curtain of chaos, never to withdraw.
Still...
Suddenly, an incongruous bright spot appears in the darkness.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Huh? What is that...
At the center of the storm, the tiny spot of light grows increasingly visible, drawing closer and closer, and then...
[Screen shakes with white flash][Background: WhiteSands Storm]
Bang! A battered vehicle bursts out of the storm, followed by piercing screams. The girl chasing desperately behind the car grimaces in terror, her shrieks cutting through the air.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Wait! Wait for me! LET ME GET ON FIRST!!!
